title: Visio: Desktop MCP server lets AI clients create and edit diagrams
summary: The briefing passes: its planned capabilities and release targets match the roadmap, and searches found no Visio-specific setup, controls or pricing documentation. The Agent 365 blocking explanation needs to specify governed-path enforcement rather than imply endpoint shutdown; two diagram examples need an additional citation.

claims.where: controls[1].ui; Governance controls table; Governance guidance: At rollout
claims.claim: Microsoft 365 admin center > Agents > Tools > Registry > MCP server > Block is the registered-server blocking path.
claims.quote: Select Agents > Tools, and then select the Registry tab. ... Select an MCP server from the list to open its overview pane. ... Select Block to restrict the server across your organization

claims.where: controls[1].api; Governance controls table
claims.claim: No API or automation equivalent for the Agent 365 registry's server Block action is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: Agent 365 MCP server registry block Microsoft Graph API PowerShell; Microsoft Graph MCP server registry block update API. Read management and develop-mcp reference; no registry Block API, and CLI block was removed.

claims.where: controls[1].governs and scope; Governance controls table
claims.claim: The registry's server Block control restricts a registered MCP server across the organisation.
claims.quote: Select Block to restrict the server across your organization, or Unblock to restore access to a previously blocked server.

claims.where: controls[1].note; Governance controls table and prose
claims.claim: Blocking an MCP server disables all tools it exposes.
claims.quote: Blocking an MCP server disables all the tools it exposes. ... Blocking an MCP server (including WorkIQ MCP) blocks usage through governed Agent 365 and Microsoft 365 admin center (MAC) pathways.
claims.fix: Replace 'Blocking disables all tools the server exposes' in controls[1].note and the matching table and prose with 'Blocking disables all tools the server exposes through governed Agent 365 and Microsoft 365 admin center pathways; it does not automatically disable the underlying API or service endpoint outside those pathways.' Keep the existing caveat that Visio integration is unconfirmed. The cited management page now states this boundary explicitly.
